utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Madam Registrar, please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-05-88-A, the Prosecutor versus Popovic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And may I have the appearances. Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MS. BASSETT
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Marisa Bassett for the Prosecution with Peter Kremer and Case Manager Janet Stewart.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And for the Defence, for Mr. Popovic?

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Mira Tapuskovic. I am co-counsel for Mr. Vujadin Popovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And for Mr. Beara?

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President, good afternoon. My name is John Ostojic. I'm here for Mr. Ljubisa Beara.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes. And Mr. Nikolic?

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Jelena Nikolic on behalf of Drago Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thanks. And for Mr. Miletic?

utterances.speaker: MR. PETRUSIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Nenad Petrusic. I'm co-counsel for Mr. Miletic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And Mr. Pandurevic?

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Peter Haynes for Vinko Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And may I now ascertain from the Appellants whether they are able to follow the proceedings in a language they understand. And I ask first Mr. Popovic. Are you able to follow the proceedings or are you having some difficulties? THE USHER: He has a problem. THE APPELLANT POPOVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have not been receiving interpretation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Well, that will be attended to. I'll get back to you. Mr. Beara? THE APPELLANT BEARA: [Interpretation] I can hear and understand everything. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Nikolic -- THE APPELLANT MILETIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I can hear and understand everything.

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Nikolic is not present in the court today. I believe you have been notified.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, and we have a waiver of appearance from Mr. Nikolic, yes. So it's Mr. Miletic then. THE APPELLANT MILETIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I can hear you and understand everything.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And Mr. Pandurevic? THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC: [Interpretation] I am hearing interpretation and everything is fine.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: May I now return to Mr. Popovic. THE APPELLANT POPOVIC: [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Well, I can see from the smile on your face. THE APPELLANT POPOVIC: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Then I'm going to begin with a summary of the recent decisions issued by the Chamber in this case. On the 29th of April of this year, the Chamber issued a public decision dismissing Mr. Popovic's eighth motion under Rule 115. On the 2nd of May, 2014, the Chamber issued a confidential decision dismissing Mr. Popovic's third and fifth motions under Rule 115. On the 23rd of May, 2014, the Chamber issued a public redacted version of this decision. And the 27th of May, 2014, the Chamber issued a confidential decision granting a request by the Prosecution for augmentation of protective measures of one witness. On the 23rd of June, 2014, and 8th July 2014, the Chamber issued confidential decisions dismissing two motions filed by Mr. Nikolic under Rule 115. And today a decision was issued on Mr. Popovic's sixth motion under Rule 115. I have to say the motion was dismissed. And I now give a summary of the status of the pending motions and decisions. The Chamber is currently seized of one motion filed by Mr. Popovic pursuant to Rule 115, his seventh, and this was filed on 11 November 2013. There is also one motion filed by Mr. Nikolic, his fourth under Rule 115, filed on the 25th of November, 2013. All responses and replies have been received by the Appeals Chamber, and the motions remain under consideration by the Chamber. I would now like to enquire from the Appellants whether they have anything to say about the status of their health or any other matter relating to the conditions of their detention. And I begin first with Mr. Popovic. THE APPELLANT POPOVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, nothing to raise. Everything is fine. There is nothing of importance that would need to be dealt with here in the courtroom.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Beara? THE APPELLANT BEARA: [Interpretation] Everything is as usual. There are no problems.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, Mr. Nikolic is absent so his counsel?

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. We can say that Mr. Nikolic's health status is in keeping with the report you have received a few months ago through Registry. If you have any further questions, we may move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Well, it would be for you to say whether you wish to move into closed session, for anything further that you wish to raise.

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have not received any authorisation from my client to raise any issues at this time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes. Thank you. Mr. Miletic? THE APPELLANT MILETIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, my health is satisfactory at the moment. I have no problems to report.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And Mr. Pandurevic? THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, detention conditions are sound. I have no objections. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And may I now ask whether there are any other the matters to be raised by the Prosecution or any of the counsel for the Appellants. The Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MS. BASSETT
utterances.text: The Prosecution has nothing to raise at this time, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Any of the Defence counsel?

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: Just one thing, Your Honour. It's come to my attention today that this is the last occasion that we'll see Mr. Peter Kremer in the courtroom, and I thought I ought to say on behalf of myself and my colleagues in the Defence that we thank him for his professionalism and his collegiality over the years, and we wish him a long and successful retirement.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Well, Mr. Kremer, I was not aware that you would be leaving us. Otherwise I certainly would want to add my voice, and I do so now, to what has just been said, because I have worked with you for quite some time on a variety of cases and have always found you to be very, very professional, and your work of the very highest standard, and I want to wish you the very best in your future career.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Your Honour. And thank you, Mr. Haynes for the kind remarks. I am turning 65 on the 31st of July and in accordance with UN rules, policies and procedures, one cannot remain employed any longer. I might have a short contract to finish some unfinished work but that remains to be seen at the moment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Well, if you wanted anyone to say something on your behalf, I don't think you look anything like 65.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: I think you're rather like a Jack Benny who was always 39. But I certainly wish you the very best. And there being no other matters, the hearing is adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 3.42 p.m.
